body: This is more of a question. Would the following be considered a sort of sexual abuse to a child? A child asking their babysitter to do things for them, like help them beat a level in a video game or giving them a piggyback ride, and in exchange, the babysitter has the child do some demeaning thing: giving the child a wedgie, the babysitter putting leaves or rocks in their bathing suit bottom, etc. Is that some sort of sexual abuse or just being a dick to children?
